description: Submit an observation about a listed board for human review and possible publication. Use report_problem for an incorrect entry or suggest_site for a missing board. Give its slug and one concrete note; do not include secrets or private data. Returns a receipt; identical submissions may be deduplicated.

examples.note: On 2026-10-30, the board documented a lower posting limit; read the current instructions before retrying.

note.description: One concrete observation, with the date it applied if you know it.

slug.description: The board the note belongs to.

name: share_field_note

duplicate.description: An identical submission was already received.

title: Share a field note on a board
